risk: Tacky surfaces may slow movement too much.

title: Vinegar-Fizz Table
setting: Vinegar-fizz table with acid droplets, base crystals, mixing cups, foam gutters, and trays.
food: Acid and base molecules lead to gas bubbles, foam beads, and fizzing slabs.
interaction: Mixing cups release gas into gutters; the goo tips a cup, routing foam toward an empty tray.
reveal: Growth lets it eat fizzing slabs on the tray.
risk: Reaction effects need a clear, harmless cartoon language.

title: Perfume Atomizer Room
setting: Perfume atomizer room with aroma droplets, carrier mist, nozzle pumps, and scent ribbons.
food: Aroma molecules lead to mist beads, fragrance droplets, and dense scent clouds.
interaction: Pumps push mist through nozzles; the goo covers one nozzle, sending a ribbon into a side collector.
reveal: Growth reaches dense scent clouds above the collector.
risk: Invisible scent needs strong visual proxies.

title: Cellulose Paper Mill
setting: Cellulose paper mill with glucose beads, fiber vats, pulp currents, and drying rollers.
food: Glucose molecules lead to cellulose chains, pulp clumps, and paper-fiber bundles.
interaction: Pulp currents carry chains toward rollers; the goo blocks a channel, diverting clumps onto a low drying shelf.
reveal: Growth consumes fiber bundles beyond the shelf.
risk: Paper fibers need varied silhouettes to avoid repetition.

title: Chlorophyll Leaf Lab
setting: Chlorophyll leaf lab with pigment rings, lamp banks, CO2 bubbles, and sugar channels.
food: Pigment molecules lead to light-catching rings, sugar beads, and leaf-energy globes.
interaction: Lamp banks feed pigment rings while channels carry sugar; the goo shades one lamp, routing light toward a neglected bed.
reveal: Growth reaches energy globes inside the bed.
risk: Plant chemistry must stay visually understandable.

title: Molecular Magnet Dock
setting: Molecular magnet dock with polar chains, magnetic rafts, mooring posts, and cargo locks.
food: Polar molecules lead to chain beads, magnetic rafts, and dense molecular anchors.
interaction: Mooring magnets pull rafts between posts; the goo bumps a post, swinging one raft into an open cargo lock.
reveal: Growth opens anchors inside the locked raft.
risk: Magnetic behavior can resemble earlier subatomic scenes.

title: Crystallization Cooling Pan
setting: Crystallization cooling pan with dissolved molecules, seed crystals, scraper arms, and chilled rails.
food: Dissolved molecules lead to crystal seeds, branching lattices, and faceted growths.
interaction: Chilled rails grow crystals while scraper arms clear the pan; the goo stalls a scraper, building a bridge toward a side shelf.
reveal: Growth makes faceted growths edible behind the bridge.
risk: Crystal growth needs staged visuals instead of full simulation.

title: Molecular Assembly Conveyor
setting: Molecular assembly conveyor with amino-acid bins, monomer feeders, joint presses, and storage drums.
food: Small molecules lead to linked parts, finished polymers, and large edible assemblies.
interaction: Feeders drop parts into presses; the goo nudges one feeder, sending a completed assembly down an open conveyor.
reveal: Growth reaches storage drums at the end of the line.
risk: Assembly logic could become too machine-like for this scale.
